# MadLava 0.1.0 Exhaustive Build Plan

**Plan:** ML-BP-0.1.0-EXHAUSTIVE
**Date:** 2026-07-21
**Normative source:** MadLava-0.1.0-Complete-Technical-Specification-Updated.md
**Independent article source:** C:/ANGEL/Personal/Articles/🌋 MadLava Feel The Lava ☕.docx
**Repository state:** planning artifacts only; no product implementation exists.

## Executive summary

This rewrite replaces broad/token-based coverage with 4270 atomic semantic records, 274 public configuration-key records, 689 exact output-field records, 24 feature contracts, 309 focused tasks, 3790 task tests, 27 distinct stage tests, 8 cumulative iteration tests, and 11 compatibility lanes. The article was independently extracted and reviewed for intent, semantics, safety, bytecode lessons, operational limitations, and evidence language. Its future-roadmap ideas are not silently promoted into 0.1 requirements.

## Authority and conflict resolution

The updated specification wins. The article controls incorporated semantics and intent where compatible. The `spark42` profile is normative; older `spark4` command examples are corrected. Configuration selects exactly one external source. The final stability gate is 24 hours. The updated specification is copied byte-for-byte or line-ending-normalized to `MadLava-0.1.0-Complete-Technical-Specification.md`, and that normalization is hash-audited.

## Repository assessment and prior-plan gap summary

There is no product code, build, test, viewer, documentation set, or distribution. The previous plan had 29 oversized tasks, 221 keyword-token records, incomplete table/default/field coverage, merged external configuration wording, `spark4`, an 8-hour final stress gate, broad wildcard test commands, generalized feature/Spark/viewer contracts, and insufficient independent article traceability. BUILD-PLAN-GAP-AUDIT.md provides the full correction log.

## Planning principles and Git lifecycle

At iteration start: verify prior tracked tree clean and prior remote hash, fetch, record accepted base, create `Iteration-NN` from that exact commit, and perform no work beforehand. At completion: run all task, stage, current iteration, prior iteration, packaged, artifact, compatibility, backward-schema/viewer, security, privacy, and bounded-resource suites; inspect intended files; commit; verify clean tracked tree; rerun certification against exact committed HEAD; correct and repeat if needed; push only the certified HEAD; verify `refs/heads/Iteration-NN` equals local HEAD. Final hash evidence is external CI evidence keyed by commit, avoiding self-reference.

## Architectural dependency map

Maven and artifact contracts -> authoritative metadata and schemas -> startup/shutdown and feature capabilities -> bounded aggregation/scheduler/encoding/writer -> useful low-cost features/viewer -> transformer/bridge/loader safety -> targeted probes -> advanced diagnostics/control/overhead -> Spark-neutral SPI -> Spark 3.5 -> Spark 4/PySpark -> complete viewer -> 24-hour hardening/reproducible release.

## Exact cross-cutting semantic contracts

- Configuration loads defaults, selects exactly one external source (explicit, otherwise classpath, otherwise working directory, otherwise none), merges that object recursively with array replacement, then applies supported scalar arguments. Boolean flags without equals mean true; unsupported complex arguments fail validation.
- Method timing is inclusive `System.nanoTime()` elapsed time. Nested work, blocking, GC, and scheduling remain included; concurrent totals may exceed wall time. Output includes startedCount, completedCount, normalExitCount, exceptionalExitCount, weakly consistent unfinishedCount, interval deltas, total/min/max/average, with sampling before timer allocation.
- Throwable output separately retains createdCount, explicitThrowCount, jfrThrowCount, thrownCount, propagatedExitCount, and caughtInternallyEstimate; no ambiguous `exceptions` field exists.
- Serialization emits byteAccuracy and byteMeasurementMethod. Root operations, nested Java/Kryo/custom activity, buffering, compression, stream history, handles, success, and failure remain distinguishable from constructor counts.
- I/O retains observed class/layer. Neither agent nor viewer sums wrapper layers as physical bytes without an explicitly selected physical boundary.
- Missing data distinguishes no event, exclusion, pre-activation loading, sampling, overflow, throttle, degradation, unsupported source, other JVM, Python-only activity, and unavailable source.
- Insights name observation, source, threshold, limitation, and suggested next experiment; causal-wording golden tests reject automatic root-cause claims. Viewer wording uses insight, suspicion, and suggested experiment.
- The operational workflow is defaults -> reproduce -> self-observability baseline -> one narrow probe -> exact method/class/package order -> exclude noise -> repeat identical workload -> compare interval/correlated evidence -> change one factor -> widen only on evidence -> short deep window -> remove agent unless intentionally retained.

## Exact bytecode regression contract

Tests enumerate IRETURN, LRETURN, FRETURN, DRETURN, ARETURN, RETURN; one-slot/two-slot values; primitive/object/array/void; static/private/synchronized/recursive/overloaded/bridge/synthetic/lambda/multiple-return/local-handler methods; implicit propagation; synthetic catch-all exits; separate ATHROW; Throwable identity; exactly one semantic start/completion; constructor chains/direct-super/failure-before-init/records/nested/anonymous; and `Child(){ super(new Helper()); }`, proving Helper construction is not Child.this initialization. Loader tests cover bootstrap conditional extraction/dependencies, application/child-first/Spark loaders, weak cleanup, named modules, narrow redefineModule/no broad opening, class-resource hierarchy/no Class.forName initialization, safe Object fallback or skip, bounded first/last failures, and JDK11/17/21 verification.

## Spark exactness contract

The Spark inventory and requirements retain every specification field/action/state/limit. Driver actions explicitly include collect, collectAsList, take, head, first, toLocalIterator, show, showString, PySpark bridges, toPandas, Arrow, and RDD collect, collectAsync, take, top, takeOrdered, takeSample, toLocalIterator, countByValue, collectPartitions. Persistence includes cache, persist, persist(StorageLevel), unpersist, unpersist(boolean), CACHE TABLE, UNCACHE TABLE, clear cache, materialization, reuse, eviction, and block loss. Planning, analysis, optimization, physical planning, execution, and explain are never forced solely for reporting.

## Test architecture

Every test record in the JSON supplies ID, category, exact requirements, fixture, preconditions, lane, configuration, packaged-artifact flag, setup, action, exact and negative assertions, expected fields/accuracy/availability/logs, resource bounds, class/file, exact command, timeout, evidence, and failure meaning. CSV-001..010, SER-JAVA-001..004, SER-KRYO-001..004, PY-EX-001..006, and additional parser/analysis/driver/executor/scheduler/serializer/Py4J/Python failures remain stable scenario IDs; tests forbid job/stage/task attribution before those entities exist.

The repository contains planning artifacts only; this capability is not implemented.

**Implementation contract**
- Classes and methods: create com.madlava.i01.s02.MinimalFeatureRegistry, MinimalFeatureRegistryConfiguration, MinimalFeatureRegistrySnapshot, and a narrow MinimalFeatureRegistry callback or service interface; method names follow the mapped event actions and DTO fields exactly.
- Configuration keys: none introduced by this task.
- Output fields: none introduced by this task.
- Feature states: DISABLED, INITIALIZING, RUNNING, THROTTLED, DEGRADED, FAILED, UNSUPPORTED, STOPPED when this task owns feature behavior.
- Accuracy and availability: publish exact source-specific accuracy and distinguish no event, exclusion, pre-activation, sampling, overflow, throttling, degradation, unsupported, other JVM, Python-only, and unavailable.
- Privacy: capture no arguments, returns, payloads, messages, credentials, literals, full paths, full endpoints, Python objects, or tokens by default.
- Cardinality and resources: enforce metadata-defined caps; no blocking, file I/O, JSON, sorting, unbounded stacks, or global locks on observed hot paths.
- Concurrency: callbacks are reentrant-safe and fail-open; snapshots are immutable and may be weakly consistent only when labelled.
- Compatibility: compile to class-file 55; use only lanes introduced by I01; optional capabilities degrade explicitly.
- Failure and degradation: catch agent errors, preserve target behavior, increment bounded diagnostics, rate-limit first/last failure evidence, and isolate the smallest capability.

**Current repository state**

The repository contains planning artifacts only; this capability is not implemented.

**Implementation contract**
- Classes and methods: create com.madlava.i01.s02.ExampleApplicationAndMinimumConfiguration, ExampleApplicationAndMinimumConfigurationConfiguration, ExampleApplicationAndMinimumConfigurationSnapshot, and a narrow ExampleApplicationAndMinimumConfiguration callback or service interface; method names follow the mapped event actions and DTO fields exactly.
- Configuration keys: configuration.onError, configuration.reload.enabled, configuration.reload.intervalSeconds, configuration.strict, configuration.writeEffectiveConfiguration.
- Output fields: none introduced by this task.
- Feature states: DISABLED, INITIALIZING, RUNNING, THROTTLED, DEGRADED, FAILED, UNSUPPORTED, STOPPED when this task owns feature behavior.
- Accuracy and availability: publish exact source-specific accuracy and distinguish no event, exclusion, pre-activation, sampling, overflow, throttling, degradation, unsupported, other JVM, Python-only, and unavailable.
- Privacy: capture no arguments, returns, payloads, messages, credentials, literals, full paths, full endpoints, Python objects, or tokens by default.
- Cardinality and resources: enforce metadata-defined caps; no blocking, file I/O, JSON, sorting, unbounded stacks, or global locks on observed hot paths.
- Concurrency: callbacks are reentrant-safe and fail-open; snapshots are immutable and may be weakly consistent only when labelled.
- Compatibility: compile to class-file 55; use only lanes introduced by I01; optional capabilities degrade explicitly.
- Failure and degradation: catch agent errors, preserve target behavior, increment bounded diagnostics, rate-limit first/last failure evidence, and isolate the smallest capability.

**Implementation contract**
- Classes and methods: create com.madlava.i01.s03.IterationDocumentationAndDemonstration, IterationDocumentationAndDemonstrationConfiguration, IterationDocumentationAndDemonstrationSnapshot, and a narrow IterationDocumentationAndDemonstration callback or service interface; method names follow the mapped event actions and DTO fields exactly.
- Configuration keys: none introduced by this task.
- Output fields: none introduced by this task.
- Feature states: DISABLED, INITIALIZING, RUNNING, THROTTLED, DEGRADED, FAILED, UNSUPPORTED, STOPPED when this task owns feature behavior.
- Accuracy and availability: publish exact source-specific accuracy and distinguish no event, exclusion, pre-activation, sampling, overflow, throttling, degradation, unsupported, other JVM, Python-only, and unavailable.
- Privacy: capture no arguments, returns, payloads, messages, credentials, literals, full paths, full endpoints, Python objects, or tokens by default.
- Cardinality and resources: enforce metadata-defined caps; no blocking, file I/O, JSON, sorting, unbounded stacks, or global locks on observed hot paths.
- Concurrency: callbacks are reentrant-safe and fail-open; snapshots are immutable and may be weakly consistent only when labelled.
- Compatibility: compile to class-file 55; use only lanes introduced by I01; optional capabilities degrade explicitly.
- Failure and degradation: catch agent errors, preserve target behavior, increment bounded diagnostics, rate-limit first/last failure evidence, and isolate the smallest capability.

- Feature states: DISABLED, INITIALIZING, RUNNING, THROTTLED, DEGRADED, FAILED, UNSUPPORTED, STOPPED when this task owns feature behavior.

- Cardinality and resources: enforce metadata-defined caps; no blocking, file I/O, JSON, sorting, unbounded stacks, or global locks on observed hot paths.

- Compatibility: compile to class-file 55; use only lanes introduced by I02; optional capabilities degrade explicitly.
- Failure and degradation: catch agent errors, preserve target behavior, increment bounded diagnostics, rate-limit first/last failure evidence, and isolate the smallest capability.

**Current repository state**

The repository contains planning artifacts only; this capability is not implemented.

**Implementation contract**
- Classes and methods: create com.madlava.i02.s02.FeatureDescriptorContract, FeatureDescriptorContractConfiguration, FeatureDescriptorContractSnapshot, and a narrow FeatureDescriptorContract callback or service interface; method names follow the mapped event actions and DTO fields exactly.
- Configuration keys: none introduced by this task.
- Output fields: none introduced by this task.
- Feature states: DISABLED, INITIALIZING, RUNNING, THROTTLED, DEGRADED, FAILED, UNSUPPORTED, STOPPED when this task owns feature behavior.
- Accuracy and availability: publish exact source-specific accuracy and distinguish no event, exclusion, pre-activation, sampling, overflow, throttling, degradation, unsupported, other JVM, Python-only, and unavailable.
- Privacy: capture no arguments, returns, payloads, messages, credentials, literals, full paths, full endpoints, Python objects, or tokens by default.
- Cardinality and resources: enforce metadata-defined caps; no blocking, file I/O, JSON, sorting, unbounded stacks, or global locks on observed hot paths.
- Concurrency: callbacks are reentrant-safe and fail-open; snapshots are immutable and may be weakly consistent only when labelled.
- Compatibility: compile to class-file 55; use only lanes introduced by I02; optional capabilities degrade explicitly.
- Failure and degradation: catch agent errors, preserve target behavior, increment bounded diagnostics, rate-limit first/last failure evidence, and isolate the smallest capability.

#### I02-S02-T07 - Runtime capability registry

**Objective**

Deliver one independently usable and verifiable Runtime capability registry contract without implementing another public feature.

**Atomic requirements covered**
- REQ-TASK-I02S02T07

**Specification and article references**
- Cross-section decomposition lines derived from mapped inventory

**Prerequisites**
- I02-S02-T06

**Current repository state**

The repository contains planning artifacts only; this capability is not implemented.

**Implementation contract**
- Classes and methods: create com.madlava.i02.s02.RuntimeCapabilityRegistry, RuntimeCapabilityRegistryConfiguration, RuntimeCapabilityRegistrySnapshot, and a narrow RuntimeCapabilityRegistry callback or service interface; method names follow the mapped event actions and DTO fields exactly.
- Configuration keys: none introduced by this task.
- Output fields: none introduced by this task.
- Feature states: DISABLED, INITIALIZING, RUNNING, THROTTLED, DEGRADED, FAILED, UNSUPPORTED, STOPPED when this task owns feature behavior.
- Accuracy and availability: publish exact source-specific accuracy and distinguish no event, exclusion, pre-activation, sampling, overflow, throttling, degradation, unsupported, other JVM, Python-only, and unavailable.
- Privacy: capture no arguments, returns, payloads, messages, credentials, literals, full paths, full endpoints, Python objects, or tokens by default.
- Cardinality and resources: enforce metadata-defined caps; no blocking, file I/O, JSON, sorting, unbounded stacks, or global locks on observed hot paths.
- Concurrency: callbacks are reentrant-safe and fail-open; snapshots are immutable and may be weakly consistent only when labelled.
- Compatibility: compile to class-file 55; use only lanes introduced by I02; optional capabilities degrade explicitly.
- Failure and degradation: catch agent errors, preserve target behavior, increment bounded diagnostics, rate-limit first/last failure evidence, and isolate the smallest capability.

**Current repository state**

The repository contains planning artifacts only; this capability is not implemented.

**Implementation contract**
- Classes and methods: create com.madlava.i02.s02.FeatureErrorAccounting, FeatureErrorAccountingConfiguration, FeatureErrorAccountingSnapshot, and a narrow FeatureErrorAccounting callback or service interface; method names follow the mapped event actions and DTO fields exactly.
- Configuration keys: none introduced by this task.
- Output fields: none introduced by this task.
- Feature states: DISABLED, INITIALIZING, RUNNING, THROTTLED, DEGRADED, FAILED, UNSUPPORTED, STOPPED when this task owns feature behavior.
- Accuracy and availability: publish exact source-specific accuracy and distinguish no event, exclusion, pre-activation, sampling, overflow, throttling, degradation, unsupported, other JVM, Python-only, and unavailable.
- Privacy: capture no arguments, returns, payloads, messages, credentials, literals, full paths, full endpoints, Python objects, or tokens by default.
- Cardinality and resources: enforce metadata-defined caps; no blocking, file I/O, JSON, sorting, unbounded stacks, or global locks on observed hot paths.
- Concurrency: callbacks are reentrant-safe and fail-open; snapshots are immutable and may be weakly consistent only when labelled.
- Compatibility: compile to class-file 55; use only lanes introduced by I02; optional capabilities degrade explicitly.
- Failure and degradation: catch agent errors, preserve target behavior, increment bounded diagnostics, rate-limit first/last failure evidence, and isolate the smallest capability.

The repository contains planning artifacts only; this capability is not implemented.

**Implementation contract**
- Classes and methods: create com.madlava.i02.s02.FeatureCircuitBreaker, FeatureCircuitBreakerConfiguration, FeatureCircuitBreakerSnapshot, and a narrow FeatureCircuitBreaker callback or service interface; method names follow the mapped event actions and DTO fields exactly.
- Configuration keys: none introduced by this task.
- Output fields: none introduced by this task.
- Feature states: DISABLED, INITIALIZING, RUNNING, THROTTLED, DEGRADED, FAILED, UNSUPPORTED, STOPPED when this task owns feature behavior.
- Accuracy and availability: publish exact source-specific accuracy and distinguish no event, exclusion, pre-activation, sampling, overflow, throttling, degradation, unsupported, other JVM, Python-only, and unavailable.
- Privacy: capture no arguments, returns, payloads, messages, credentials, literals, full paths, full endpoints, Python objects, or tokens by default.
- Cardinality and resources: enforce metadata-defined caps; no blocking, file I/O, JSON, sorting, unbounded stacks, or global locks on observed hot paths.
- Concurrency: callbacks are reentrant-safe and fail-open; snapshots are immutable and may be weakly consistent only when labelled.
- Compatibility: compile to class-file 55; use only lanes introduced by I02; optional capabilities degrade explicitly.
- Failure and degradation: catch agent errors, preserve target behavior, increment bounded diagnostics, rate-limit first/last failure evidence, and isolate the smallest capability.

- Compatibility: compile to class-file 55; use only lanes introduced by I03; optional capabilities degrade explicitly.
- Failure and degradation: catch agent errors, preserve target behavior, increment bounded diagnostics, rate-limit first/last failure evidence, and isolate the smallest capability.

- Failure and degradation: catch agent errors, preserve target behavior, increment bounded diagnostics, rate-limit first/last failure evidence, and isolate the smallest capability.

**Current repository state**

The repository contains planning artifacts only; this capability is not implemented.

**Implementation contract**
- Classes and methods: create com.madlava.i03.s02.RuntimeBridgeAPI, RuntimeBridgeAPIConfiguration, RuntimeBridgeAPISnapshot, and a narrow RuntimeBridgeAPI callback or service interface; method names follow the mapped event actions and DTO fields exactly.
- Configuration keys: none introduced by this task.
- Output fields: none introduced by this task.
- Feature states: DISABLED, INITIALIZING, RUNNING, THROTTLED, DEGRADED, FAILED, UNSUPPORTED, STOPPED when this task owns feature behavior.
- Accuracy and availability: publish exact source-specific accuracy and distinguish no event, exclusion, pre-activation, sampling, overflow, throttling, degradation, unsupported, other JVM, Python-only, and unavailable.
- Privacy: capture no arguments, returns, payloads, messages, credentials, literals, full paths, full endpoints, Python objects, or tokens by default.
- Cardinality and resources: enforce metadata-defined caps; no blocking, file I/O, JSON, sorting, unbounded stacks, or global locks on observed hot paths.
- Concurrency: callbacks are reentrant-safe and fail-open; snapshots are immutable and may be weakly consistent only when labelled.
- Compatibility: compile to class-file 55; use only lanes introduced by I03; optional capabilities degrade explicitly.
- Failure and degradation: catch agent errors, preserve target behavior, increment bounded diagnostics, rate-limit first/last failure evidence, and isolate the smallest capability.

- Classes and methods: create com.madlava.i04.s03.GenericJava11PackagedCertification, GenericJava11PackagedCertificationConfiguration, GenericJava11PackagedCertificationSnapshot, and a narrow GenericJava11PackagedCertification callback or service interface; method names follow the mapped event actions and DTO fields exactly.

- Output fields: none introduced by this task.
- Feature states: DISABLED, INITIALIZING, RUNNING, THROTTLED, DEGRADED, FAILED, UNSUPPORTED, STOPPED when this task owns feature behavior.
- Accuracy and availability: publish exact source-specific accuracy and distinguish no event, exclusion, pre-activation, sampling, overflow, throttling, degradation, unsupported, other JVM, Python-only, and unavailable.
- Privacy: capture no arguments, returns, payloads, messages, credentials, literals, full paths, full endpoints, Python objects, or tokens by default.
- Cardinality and resources: enforce metadata-defined caps; no blocking, file I/O, JSON, sorting, unbounded stacks, or global locks on observed hot paths.
- Concurrency: callbacks are reentrant-safe and fail-open; snapshots are immutable and may be weakly consistent only when labelled.
- Compatibility: compile to class-file 55; use only lanes introduced by I04; optional capabilities degrade explicitly.
- Failure and degradation: catch agent errors, preserve target behavior, increment bounded diagnostics, rate-limit first/last failure evidence, and isolate the smallest capability.

- Failure and degradation: catch agent errors, preserve target behavior, increment bounded diagnostics, rate-limit first/last failure evidence, and isolate the smallest capability.

- Compatibility: compile to class-file 55; use only lanes introduced by I05; optional capabilities degrade explicitly.
- Failure and degradation: catch agent errors, preserve target behavior, increment bounded diagnostics, rate-limit first/last failure evidence, and isolate the smallest capability.

- Feature states: DISABLED, INITIALIZING, RUNNING, THROTTLED, DEGRADED, FAILED, UNSUPPORTED, STOPPED when this task owns feature behavior.
- Accuracy and availability: publish exact source-specific accuracy and distinguish no event, exclusion, pre-activation, sampling, overflow, throttling, degradation, unsupported, other JVM, Python-only, and unavailable.
- Privacy: capture no arguments, returns, payloads, messages, credentials, literals, full paths, full endpoints, Python objects, or tokens by default.
- Cardinality and resources: enforce metadata-defined caps; no blocking, file I/O, JSON, sorting, unbounded stacks, or global locks on observed hot paths.
- Concurrency: callbacks are reentrant-safe and fail-open; snapshots are immutable and may be weakly consistent only when labelled.
- Compatibility: compile to class-file 55; use only lanes introduced by I05; optional capabilities degrade explicitly.
- Failure and degradation: catch agent errors, preserve target behavior, increment bounded diagnostics, rate-limit first/last failure evidence, and isolate the smallest capability.

- Cardinality and resources: enforce metadata-defined caps; no blocking, file I/O, JSON, sorting, unbounded stacks, or global locks on observed hot paths.
- Concurrency: callbacks are reentrant-safe and fail-open; snapshots are immutable and may be weakly consistent only when labelled.
- Compatibility: compile to class-file 55; use only lanes introduced by I07; optional capabilities degrade explicitly.
- Failure and degradation: catch agent errors, preserve target behavior, increment bounded diagnostics, rate-limit first/last failure evidence, and isolate the smallest capability.

**Current repository state**

The repository contains planning artifacts only; this capability is not implemented.

**Implementation contract**
- Classes and methods: create com.madlava.i08.s03.AllTaskCumulativeSuite, AllTaskCumulativeSuiteConfiguration, AllTaskCumulativeSuiteSnapshot, and a narrow AllTaskCumulativeSuite callback or service interface; method names follow the mapped event actions and DTO fields exactly.
- Configuration keys: none introduced by this task.
- Output fields: none introduced by this task.
- Feature states: DISABLED, INITIALIZING, RUNNING, THROTTLED, DEGRADED, FAILED, UNSUPPORTED, STOPPED when this task owns feature behavior.
- Accuracy and availability: publish exact source-specific accuracy and distinguish no event, exclusion, pre-activation, sampling, overflow, throttling, degradation, unsupported, other JVM, Python-only, and unavailable.
- Privacy: capture no arguments, returns, payloads, messages, credentials, literals, full paths, full endpoints, Python objects, or tokens by default.
- Cardinality and resources: enforce metadata-defined caps; no blocking, file I/O, JSON, sorting, unbounded stacks, or global locks on observed hot paths.
- Concurrency: callbacks are reentrant-safe and fail-open; snapshots are immutable and may be weakly consistent only when labelled.
- Compatibility: compile to class-file 55; use only lanes introduced by I08; optional capabilities degrade explicitly.
- Failure and degradation: catch agent errors, preserve target behavior, increment bounded diagnostics, rate-limit first/last failure evidence, and isolate the smallest capability.

**Risks and fallback behavior**

On uncertainty or runtime incompatibility, skip transformation or disable only this capability, preserve the application, and report PARTIAL, UNAVAILABLE, DEGRADED, or UNSUPPORTED with a reason.


## Performance and stability certification

Microbenchmarks: empty callback; method entry/exit; sampled method; instance count; Throwable count; serialization hooks; stream hooks; bounded-table contention; Spark DataFrame hooks; Py4J aggregation. End-to-end workloads: CPU-bound, allocation-heavy, exception storm, stream I/O, high thread count, Spark SQL large plan, shuffle/spill, PySpark plan chatter. Compare no-agent/default/standard/deep profiles. Measure throughput, P50/P95/P99, process CPU, allocated bytes, GC, startup, class loading, agent heap, output rate. Final gates: measurable under-1% default target on representative workloads, under-128-MiB agent-managed heap, zero application-thread disk I/O, per-feature overhead documentation, and a 24-hour no-unbounded-growth test. Unmeasurable is failure.

Compile and unit tests; integration/Failsafe; packaged child JVM; Java11 bytecode; dependency convergence; forbidden Spark/test dependencies; relocated ASM; manifest; schema; viewer unit/browser/no-network/XSS/accessibility; generic JDK11/17/21; Spark35 JDK11/17; Spark42 JDK17/21; unsupported combinations; isolated PySpark35/42; CSV/SER/Python failures; concurrency/stress; performance; privacy/security; documentation examples; reproducible build; checksums/SBOM/provenance; release archive inspection.
